# Review — ani-017-f

## Pass 1

Checks run by script (scratch `check.py`, `q.py`): the glyph codes of units.json equal the established file's exactly, in order (152 established words, 559 signs); rubric flags agree sign by sign (35 rubric words; every red/black statement in the notes agrees with the flags); every `q` indexes its glyphs 0…n−1 and equals the established `q` wherever the word is Budge's group unchanged; the six splits/joins (rdi + n·k, ꜥry·sn + n·k, ḥr-ꜥ, ꜥḥꜥ·n) are re-indexed correctly; every morph covers all its glyphs; no `det` carries a `tr`; every bolt O34 not used as a suffix has `tr` "z" (suffix ·s for ·s/·sn); no "triumphant / saith / homage / thy / hath / thee / thou" in any l or i. The established file marks the whole word psḫ·f (w24) restored; the units flag only Q3 and O34 (see Refused). `ln` of each unit checked against the packet line of its first word. Names and `say` agree with the published parts (Osiris, Isis, Nephthys, Ra, Iunu, Ani; Rehu beside the published Rehuy); ky ḏd, pw tr rf sw ("What, then, is it?"), ḥnn pw n N, "X is the name of Y", wsir Q2+D4, ꜣst Q1 X1 H8, nbt-ḥwt O9 I12, ḥr-ꜥ follow the published spellings and renderings.

- U10 · n · minor · the note called the name "very likely" Kher-aha without saying why it is not corrected · rewritten: may well be Kher-aha, named next to Heliopolis in the Spell 125 declarations, but the misprints rule does not apply (reason as above), so the name stands as written and is doubtful.

## Pass 2

Checks run by script (scratch `check.py`, `q.py`, `edit3.py`): glyph codes equal the established file's in order (559 signs), unchanged by every edit (asserted before and after); rubric flags agree sign by sign; every `q` indexes its glyphs and equals the established `q` for unchanged groups (the six splits/joins re-indexed correctly); every morph covers its glyphs; no `det` has a `tr`; non-suffix O34 all "z"; no Budge-isms in l / i. gloss.json: its keys equal exactly the set of morph lemmas absent from known-lemmas.json (27, with ꜥnḏ in place of ꜥnd); every `__broaden__` value begins with the known entry verbatim followed by " · ", and every broadened lemma is used in units.json with the new sense (ḥm U0/U1, sꜣw U1, sꜣ U19, štꜣ U21, n "because of" U0). Every Budge spelling in gloss.json checked against the packet's transliteration line. The four new signs (B2, M30, M42, T34) are already in signs-egyptian.json.

Restored flags settled: the build (`hooks.py` assemble) carries `restored` only from glyphs, never from the word, and `validate` does not compare restored flags with the established file at all; ani-017-e's units flag the single sign D37 in rdyt although the established word carries `"restored": true`. So the glyph-level flags on Q3 and O34 in psḫ·f (the two signs inside Budge's brackets) are what the build expects. No change.
